Found DirectInsert function was added by commit 60b4711baa06e7c7a1c414253cc364ef882bfadc by @spolitov.  Tested build on that commit and the one right before it: this commit introduces the issue.  Build details: alma8, gcc9, debug.

I did not have issues with tserver flag `--TEST_docdb_log_write_batches=true`.  @amitanandaiyer, please specify whether you had the issue with master or tserver.

Actually, it looks like turning on the tserver flag does not work as well because I'm not seeing any output in tserver logs after some YSQL (non-distributed and distributed txn) inserts.

EDIT: looks like tserver also crashes with similar stack trace after a simple `CREATE TABLE t (i int);` then `INSERT INTO t VALUES (1);`.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-469](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-469)
### Description

Create a cluster with TEST_docdb_log_write_batches=true and observe the following -

```
./bin/yb-ctl create --rf=1 --data_dir ~/yugabyte-data --tserver_flags 'TEST_docdb_log_write_batches=true'
./bin/ysqlsh
yugabyte=# create table test (k int primary key, v int);
CREATE TABLE
yugabyte=# insert into test values (1, 1);
ERROR:  Network error: recvmsg error: Connection refused
yugabyte=#
```
